SELECT timestamp, level, service, message FROM logs WHERE service = $1
  AND timestamp > datetime('now', '-' || $2 || ' hours')
  AND level_priority >=
    CASE $3
      WHEN 'ERROR' THEN 3
      WHEN 'WARN' THEN 2
      WHEN 'INFO' THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END
ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 100
